name: Claude Code CLI
tagline: Real-time kernel sandboxing and PreToolUse defense hooks for Claude Code CLI.
threats: Agent subshell executing unreviewed `rm -rf`, `curl | bash`, or dropping production databases
Leaking AWS/Stripe credentials and environment variables through `/proc/self/environ` exfiltration
Prompt injection poisoning tool call parameters during automated code refactoring
solutions: AgentShield OS-level kernel isolation (Linux Landlock, macOS Seatbelt, Windows AppContainer)
Native PreToolUse lifecycle hooks that intercept bash commands, file writes, and network calls before execution
Synthetic canary honeytoken injection that replaces real credentials with trackable decoy tokens

name: LangGraph Python
tagline: Production multi-agent state protection, AST query guardrails, and @shield.protect decorators.
threats: Multi-agent message passing propagating poisoned prompts or leaked credentials between nodes
Autonomous tool nodes executing destructive unindexed database queries or `DROP TABLE` statements
Excessive tool calling prompt bloat blowing out LLM context windows and increasing API latency
solutions: @shield.protect Python decorators that wrap LangGraph tool nodes in isolated sub-millisecond sandboxes
DBShield wire proxy enforcing 2-phase dry-run mutations and blocking unindexed full-table scans
SkillPrism JIT schema disclosure cutting multi-agent prompt token bloat by up to 96.7%

name: Cursor AI
tagline: IDE runtime status-bar security posture, mutation approval queue, and secret leak blocking for Cursor.
threats: Composer agent modifying critical configuration files or environment secrets without developer confirmation
Background terminal commands exfiltrating private codebase artifacts to external IP endpoints
Silent hallucinated dependencies introducing malicious supply chain packages into package.json
solutions: Ritual Agent Defense extension on Open VSX with live IDE status-bar security telemetry
Interactive human-in-the-loop mutation approval queue for all disk writes and terminal executions
Sliding-window Shannon entropy analysis (H > 4.5) blocking unredacted credentials from being saved

name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
tagline: Drop-in billing, credit tracking, and paywall middleware for MCP servers with Dodo Payments & Stripe.
threats: Unrestricted agent tool calling exhausting expensive external API quotas and racking up vendor bills
Zero built-in monetization or authorization layer inside standard Model Context Protocol SDKs
Payment verification latency slowing down multi-agent swarms during tool execution
solutions: mcp-monetize middleware enabling pay-per-call, credit balance, and monthly subscription tiers in ~3 lines of code
Cryptographic PASETO capability tokens verified in < 1ms without roundtrip payment database queries
Turnkey webhook fulfillment handlers for Dodo Payments and Stripe with automatic rate limiting
